note: Step 2's tree and source, plus a tag whose one member is `scb/sample/kon`, the slug both refused names took. A refused name forms nothing, but the FQID it would have taken is withheld with both refused identities as its cause, so the tag member is pruned like a dependent of any other withheld variable: one `withheld_catalog_dependency` per cause, error like the cause, carrying both identities' source refs. The tag stays with no member. Before the fix the refused FQID was simply absent and the build aborted with `catalog_dependency_missing`.
fails_if: `resolve_source_scope` (source_scope.py) stops keying a refused name's unresolved identity under the FQID its slug would have taken (`withheld_fqid`), or `compile_curation` (curation_compile.py) stops keeping the merged-scope refused declarations in `refused_naming`, so the tag member is reported `catalog_dependency_missing` and the build aborts

sources.description: Variable 5 delivers Kon in 2020 (CVID 20) and KON in 2021 (CVID 21); variable 6 delivers SEX (CVID 22) in 2020.
